$comment: Telegram news-source registry for the breaking-news listener. Categories are markets|macro|trump|geopolitics|traders|crypto|india. The listener subscribes to each enabled channel and routes its messages into the matching category topic. Set enabled:false to mute a source without deleting it. Per-source slug is the public Telegram @handle WITHOUT the leading @. Broad-macro breaking keywords live in services/alerts/macroBreakingGate.js, NOT here — this file only declares which channels to listen to.
